description: React component for adding and managing slices (charts) in a dashboard, including filtering, sorting, and drag-and-drop functionality.

classes.name: SliceAdder
classes.description: React component class for managing slice addition, filtering, sorting, and drag-and-drop in a dashboard context.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Update filtered slices and selected slice IDs when props change.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: Update redux store with selected slices and abort ongoing fetch request.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Debounced handler for search input changes, triggers slice fetch.

methods.name: searchUpdated
methods.description: Update state with new search term and filtered slices.

methods.name: handleSelect
methods.description: Change sorting key and update filtered slices.

methods.name: rowRenderer
methods.description: Render individual slice item with drag-and-drop support.

methods.name: onShowOnlyMyCharts
methods.description: Toggle filter to show only user's charts and update filtered slices.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Render the component UI including filter controls, list of slices, and drag preview.
